text: Tuma nde Muusaa joginoo waare musiɗɗo makko on e hoore makko nden himo pooɗa nde e makko himo monanii mo fii golle makko ɗen, Haaruuna ɗaɓɓiri mo yaafuyee o maakani mo: "Wata jogito waare am nden maa leeɓi hoore am nden, miɗo mari ŋanto fii heddagol am hakkunde maɓɓe, hari miɗo huli fii wata ɓe seedu si mi accii ɓe kamɓe tun, ontuma maakaa; ko min senndi hakkunde maɓɓe, min toode mi aynaali wasiyee maaɗa on e fii maɓɓe".
